blocks.content: Quiz: How long will a cookie last if you set it without specifying an expiration?
Tap an option below to answer:
Until the user clears the browser cache
Cookies are not part of the browser cache; clearing the cache does not affect cookies.
Cookies are not part of the browser cache; clearing the cache does not affect cookies.
Until the user closes the browser
A cookie without an expiration date lasts only until the browser is closed.
A cookie without an expiration date lasts only until the browser is closed.
For one session and one page load
A cookie without an expiration date persists throughout the user's session, which includes multiple page loads within the same browsing session.
A cookie without an expiration date persists throughout the user's session, which includes multiple page loads within the same browsing session.
Only cookies with an explicitly set expiration date or max-age last indefinitely.
Only cookies with an explicitly set expiration date or max-age last indefinitely.
